additional_concerns: The trigger formula answers whether an applicable demonstration request exists; TRUE does not establish discharge, SFC satisfaction or compliance, and FALSE does not excuse confirmation or substantive duties.
Footnote 5 permits the stated harmonised reading but leaves a rival independent-demonstration reading unresolved. Preservation findings are confined to the candidate's expressly selected reading.
No actual provider facts or requests are supplied. Scope and request applicability remain supplied judgments; structural tool checks establish neither those facts nor legal correctness.

The substantive-performance candidate lacks an executable meaning and a complete applicable adequacy standard. Valuation supervision requirements cannot automatically supply that standard. The separate intermediary issuance responsibility provision likewise requires its own actor and activity scope.

The complete paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and applicable Appendix factors are not supplied. Their absence limits substantive assessment, although it does not prevent comparison of the narrow request-trigger formula.
Confirmation timing, renewal, demonstration deadlines and the broader attachment of SFC satisfaction or high confidence remain unresolved. The formula introduces no such requirements.
